criteria.requirement: Add text.extract_text(tree,*,treewalker="etree",include_hidden=False,include_images=False) using actual backend walker events. Preserve reading/tail order, paragraph and br boundaries, ordered/unordered list markers, decoded entities and exact pre-internal spaces/newlines while collapsing ordinary HTML whitespace. Omit head/script/style body-irrelevant text; hidden/template are optional and explicit image alt may be included. DOM/etree produce equivalent text and input trees/serializer output remain unchanged. Do not simply concatenate Characters, drop tail or claim HTML sanitization/network fetching.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
